title.en: NVIDIA Announces Groq 3 LPX Production Milestone for Agentic AI Inference
title.zhHans: NVIDIA 宣布 Groq 3 LPX 达到面向智能体 AI 推理的生产里程碑

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA announced that Groq 3 LPX entered full production on August 24, 2026; Nebius separately announced planned early cloud adoption for its Token Factory.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 8 月 24 日宣布 Groq 3 LPX 进入全面生产；Nebius 则另行宣布计划在其 Token Factory 中率先采用。

summary.en: NVIDIA described Groq 3 LPX as in full production at Hot Chips on August 24, 2026. Nebius announced that it would be the first AI cloud to adopt the platform, initially for a subset of models on Token Factory. The announcements establish a production and integration milestone, not proof of broad cloud availability or uniform throughput in customer workloads.
summary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 8 月 24 日在 Hot Chips 上将 Groq 3 LPX 描述为已进入全面生产。Nebius 宣布将成为首家采用该平台的 AI 云服务商，初期仅在 Token Factory 中支持部分模型。这些公告确认的是生产与集成里程碑，而非广泛云端可用性或客户工作负载中一致吞吐量的证明。

narrative.en: NVIDIA and Nebius frame the LPX design around low-latency token generation for multi-step agents. NVIDIA cited a 3,400-output-token-per-second result on a specific Gemma 4 31B setup, while Nebius cited the same benchmark and described a planned integration path. NVIDIA's release also states that many products and features remain subject to availability, so EpochArc treats performance and rollout effects as vendor-reported and prospective.
narrative.zhHans: NVIDIA 与 Nebius 将 LPX 设计定位为服务多步智能体的低延迟 token 生成。NVIDIA 援引特定 Gemma 4 31B 配置下每秒 3,400 个输出 token 的结果，Nebius 也引用该基准并描述了计划中的集成路径。NVIDIA 的公告同时说明多项产品与功能仍取决于可用性，因此 EpochArc 将性能与落地效果限定为厂商报告和前瞻性表述。

description.en: Creates a production milestone for specialized low-latency inference hardware intended for multi-step agent workloads.
description.zhHans: 为面向多步智能体工作负载的专用低延迟推理硬件形成生产里程碑。

description.en: Nebius's announced integration indicates early commercial interest in specialized rack-scale inference, subject to delivery and adoption.
description.zhHans: Nebius 宣布的集成计划显示市场对专用机架级推理的早期商业兴趣，但仍取决于交付与采用。

text.en: NVIDIA announced Groq 3 LPX as in full production on August 24, 2026, and Nebius announced it as the first adopting AI cloud.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 8 月 24 日宣布 Groq 3 LPX 已进入全面生产，Nebius 宣布成为首家采用该平台的 AI 云服务商。

text.en: NVIDIA reported up to 3,400 output tokens per second on a specified Gemma 4 31B benchmark configuration, aimed at latency-sensitive agent workflows.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 报告称，在指定的 Gemma 4 31B 基准配置上最高达到每秒 3,400 个输出 token，目标是低延迟智能体工作流。

text.en: Throughput depends on the tested model and rack configuration, while cloud rollout and features remain subject to availability and partner delivery.
text.zhHans: 吞吐量取决于测试模型与机架配置，云端落地及相关功能仍受可用性与合作伙伴交付进度影响。

editorial.reviewNotes: Reviewed to separate NVIDIA's production announcement from staged cloud availability and vendor-reported performance.
